changes: Most dev failures were hidden-test wrong answers and timeouts on programs that had only passed the samples, and about half the failed runs never ran the public tests. I rewrote /agent/solver.md to make verification mandatory before submit: a brute-force random comparison and a max-size timing run, with explicit guidance to avoid O(N^3) Python loops and common pitfalls. I also added a skill, /agent/skills/stress-testing/SKILL.md, with a concrete procedure for the brute-force harness, generators, and timing. validate() passes. One trial on lcb-arc183-c passed, but the agent still skipped the brute-force and timing checks, so I added a hard gate in the prompt and did not re-trial it.
